chapter.heading: A Plea for Deliverance and ForgivenessA Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
To You,
O Lord, I lift up my soul. [Lev. 26:17, 36; Ps. 53:5]

O my
God, I trust in You;Let me not be ashamed;Let not my enemies triumph over me.

Indeed, let
no one who waits on You be ashamed;Let those be ashamed who deal treacherously without cause. [Matt. 18:28]

Show me
Your ways, O Lord;Teach me Your paths. [Ps. 49:18; Rom. 1:32 d 1 Kin. 18:18; Neh. 13:11, 15; Matt. 3:7; 14:4; Eph. 5:11]

Lead me
in Your truth and teach me,For You are the God of my salvation;On You I wait all the day. [Ps. 92:6; Is. 6:9; 44:18 f Ps. 119:100; Prov. 2:9; John 17:17; 1 Cor. 2:15; [1 John]

Remember, O
Lord, Your tender mercies and Your lovingkindnesses,For they are from of old.

Do not
remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions;According to Your mercy remember me,For Your goodness’ sake, O Lord.

Good and
upright is the Lord;Therefore He teaches sinners in the way.

The humble
He guides in justice,And the humble He teaches His way. [Ps. 66:18; 109:7; Prov. 15:8]

All the
paths of the Lord are mercy and truth,To such as keep His covenant and His testimonies. [Ps. 7:15; Prov. 26:27 i [Matt. 6:33; Heb. 6:12; 1 Pet. 3:9]]

For Your
name’s sake, O Lord,Pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

Who is
the man that fears the Lord?Him shall He teach in the way He chooses. [Prov. 11:10;]

He himself
shall dwell in prosperity,And his descendants shall inherit the earth.

The secret
of the Lord is with those who fear Him,And He will show them His covenant.

My eyes
are ever toward the Lord,For He shall pluck my feet out of the net. [Prov. 19:12; 1 Pet. 5:8 m Ex. 1:14; Prov. 29:2; Matt. 2:16]

Turn Yourself
to me, and have mercy on me,For I am desolate and afflicted. [Eccl. 10:16; Is. 3:12]

The troubles
of my heart have enlarged;Bring me out of my distresses! [Gen. 9:6]

Look on
my affliction and my pain,And forgive all my sins.

Consider my
enemies, for they are many;And they hate me with cruel hatred. [Prov. 12:11;]

Keep my
soul, and deliver me;Let me not be ashamed, for I put my trust in You. [Prov. 13:11; 20:21; 23:4; 1 Tim.]

Let integrity
and uprightness preserve me,For I wait for You. [Prov. 18:5]

Redeem Israel,
O God,Out of all their troubles! [Prov. 21:5]
